findings.detail: Source capsule pins are checked on both Linux and the mounted Windows checkout. The fixed Windows Node executable/hash, actual process.pid, exact four argv values, driver path/hash and nonce are published before Windows private/configuration/app work. Root separately inspects real Windows PID/start ticks/CIM birth/executable/hash/fixed command via PowerShell and ACKs before configuration is accepted. The WSL interop wrapper PID is explicitly not the Windows identity.

PowerShell uses exact executable/driver/nonce and registered PID/start/command identities. It guards queued-parent and queried-child reuse and birth-time bounds, captures a bounded tree, rechecks before acquired-process stop, skips recycled identities and reports unregisteredProcessesStopped=0. Cooperative anchor remains for final inspection, and Root checks its exact tree stop; no name-wide stop or arbitrary PID adoption.

Linux Root is intentionally permitted to read only this new M nest.env to derive windows-nest.env before spawn. Both files have fixed names, private directory mode, nofollow/inode/stability checks and exclusive creation; original bytes remain unchanged. Exactly one local object root changes from Linux new-M path to its new-M UNC equivalent. Windows reads only after its identity ACK, independently verifies source/derived hashes and exact derivation, and reuses the unchanged original managed admission for every environment key/role/database/port/controlled supplier value. No old private or global installation is used.

The exact Root-staged 0ef7 original Native bundle is required by the capsule and checked as a regular no-symlink file. Existing Windows dist is untouched. Real Windows NestFactory/ORM provider, original MikroORM afterCreate+outer-COMMIT witness and per-query actual pg Client.processID capture are observed. Drain delivers original committed batches and atomically refreshes cached trace/SQL/report; callback delivery failure blocks certification. PG output never substitutes for an original Native SDK certificate.

Each actual request first awaits immutable admitted run/case/index/op context. Windows itself sends fixed-host HTTP, with exact body/base64 boundary and retained actual raw response bytes/hash/length. Fixed host/request/correlation headers cannot be caller-overridden. Dispatch is finite and chosen before transport, with no response fallback. Root cookies may travel only through the new private stdio channel.

C found source01 discarded ordinary Native stdout/stderr and original caught error message/stack. Final source02 retains actual stdout/stderr chunks in a separate new-M private evidence queue and adds privateFailure original error/stack/known close causes to private stdio frames. Public append output remains only frame/stderr hash and fixed category. Close waits for both protocol and raw-stdio evidence queues, and any recorded owner failure prevents a complete result; no environment/config object dump was added.

EOF, cancellation, RPC/total deadline and channel errors abort the owner. Cooperative app close checks actual HTTP drain, SDK completion, hook restoration and Windows10070 release; Root additionally stops the registered exact Windows tree. Only both actual Native close receipt and owned-tree result can produce a complete source lifecycle. Failure/forced/incomplete paths preserve partial status and cannot authorize fixture cleanup.

Original main.ts uses app.listen(port). This source fixes clients/endpoints to loopback and verifies actual port10070; it does not prove a loopback-only listener bind address. No product/listener behavior was silently changed for this source review.
